global.description: Declares a custom Drive App (a drive-level UI surface) shipped by a Vetra Reactor Package. Use one App Module document per drive app: configure which document types it handles, whether it accepts drag-and-drop, and mark it CONFIRMED to trigger codegen of the corresponding app scaffold under `apps/`.
global.name: App Module

modules.description: Set the app's identity, lifecycle status, and the document types it handles.
modules.name: base_operations

operations.description: Set the display name of the drive app. Also determines the generated folder name under `apps/`.
operations.name: SET_APP_NAME

operations.description: Move the app between DRAFT and CONFIRMED. Codegen only runs once the status is CONFIRMED.
operations.name: SET_APP_STATUS

operations.description: Append a document type id to the list of types this app handles. Initializes the list if it was `null` (accept-any).
operations.name: ADD_DOCUMENT_TYPE

operations.description: Remove a document type id from the handled list. No-op if the type is not present.
operations.name: REMOVE_DOCUMENT_TYPE

operations.description: Replace the entire allowed-document-types list in one call. Pass an empty list to accept none.
operations.name: SET_DOCUMENT_TYPES

modules.description: Toggle drag-and-drop file handling for the app surface.
modules.name: dnd_operations

operations.description: Enable or disable drag-and-drop file handling on the app surface.
operations.name: SET_DRAG_AND_DROP_ENABLED

global.schema:
"""
Configuration for a Drive App contributed by the package. Drive apps render a
custom view at the drive level (instead of, or alongside, the document file
tree) and can opt into which document types they accept.
"""
type AppModuleState {
  """Display name of the drive app. Also used as the source for the generated folder name under `apps/`."""
  name: String!
  """Lifecycle status. While DRAFT the app definition is editable and codegen is skipped; switching to CONFIRMED triggers app scaffold generation."""
  status: StatusType!
  """Document type ids this app handles. `null` means the app accepts any document type; an empty list means it accepts none."""
  allowedDocumentTypes: [String!]
  """Whether the app surface accepts dropped files from the user. Defaults to true."""
  isDragAndDropEnabled: Boolean!
}

"""
Lifecycle status of a module definition.
- DRAFT: still being edited; codegen does not run.
- CONFIRMED: locked in; codegen produces the corresponding scaffold.
"""
enum StatusType {
  DRAFT
  CONFIRMED
}
